metadata.task: Round 118 London planning and heritage-control administrative status candidates
metadata.scope_note: Official public-sector administrative records only. Records are framed as planning, heritage-control, local-list, or community-asset status observations, not as construction, opening, occupation, causation, or outcome evidence.
